concerns.text: Phase 6 (T044-T046) introduces 'Plasticity Potential' feature engineering and molecular context analysis. This scope is absent from spec.md (no FR/SC) and plan.md. Implementing these tasks violates the 'No silent constitution drift' principle by adding unapproved research scope that the spec does not authorize.

The 'Notes' section contradicts spec.md FR-005 (n=500 permutations) by instructing: 'enforce n=500... failure to complete... should be a job error,' while T029 and plan.md explicitly reduce n to 100 for runtime. This creates a logical deadlock where the task demands a failure condition the plan explicitly avoids, weakening the FR-005 constraint.

T023 places collinearity checks 'Inside the inner CV loop' alongside feature selection. Spec FR-008 requires handling collinearity 'before model training' to prevent leakage. If the check is performed on the full inner-training set rather than strictly within folds, it violates the data hygiene constraint of FR-008 and risks inflating performance metrics.

T018 mandates 'fsl (mcflirt)' for motion correction. Spec.md Assumptions and plan.md Dependencies only list 'nibabel' and 'nilearn'. FSL is a complex system-level dependency not guaranteed on standard GitHub runners. This introduces an unverified environment constraint not authorized in the spec, risking execution failure.

T029 overrides FR-005's n=500 requirement with '100 permutations' citing runtime. While plan.md notes this reduction, the task description fails to explicitly link this override to a specific plan amendment or FR-005 exception clause, creating a semantic weakening of the FR-005 constraint without clear traceability.
